AbstractText.Label: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES
AbstractText.content: The aim of this study was to determine the relationship between filling proportion of bone cement in the vertical direction and incidence of recollapse in the augmented vertebrae after vertebral augmentation.

AbstractText.Label: METHODS
AbstractText.content: Fifty-one patients (51 vertebrae) who had operations between January 2014 and July 2016 with a mean age of 78.10 years were included. All patients in our department of spine surgery were advised to have follow-up care every 6 months. Patients characteristics, radiographic outcomes were evaluated.

AbstractText.Label: RESULTS
AbstractText.content: The recollapse of augmented vertebral body occurred in 10 of 51 vertebrae (20%).

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSION
AbstractText.content: Patients with a high proportion rate of bone cement in the middle vertical direction have a low incidence of experiencing recollapse.
